items.title: Marty Grosz interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, September 4, 1995
items.q: I didn’t know any of these guys... With Eddie Durham on electric guitar, Freddie Green, Walter Page, Jo Jones, the Basie rhythm section without Basie.

ctx.x: No. That was without Basie. With Eddie Durham on electric guitar, Freddie Green, Walter Page, Jo Jones, the Basie rhythm section without Basie. Contractual reasons obviously. And then Buck Clayton and Lester Young. And the only reason, I didn’t know any of these guys, the only reason I bought the record was because of the title, you know I hadn’t heard it and I said, “Paging the Devil,” wow, that sounds real evil and funky and stuff. And it turned out it was because Walter Page playing the blues and he had a band…
Well if that was your first record, then you had a great introduction—
